verdict.rationale: LiveKit offers a hosted cloud service, so an uptime SLA and a public status page are fair things for a founder to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions either one. Metrics on resource allocation and errors (livekit-docs-19) are a related observability feature, not a published SLA or a public status page, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
